local.trialResolution: Leaving portalLanguage changed during the first private-paint trial let the original periodic widgets read reports/documents/closures. The final pure-painter call temporarily selects the reader language and restores it in the same synchronous call; the unchanged zero-read assertion now measures only that painter. Actual language selectors separately retain the original held primary-read guard and widget reloads. Foreign pages retain their own pre-paint session baseline and allow only the original initial seen endpoint. No product guard, original assertion or deadline changed.
